messages:
Ana (releases): Heads up — EU office holiday next Tue, thinking we should shift the next biweekly release train one week earlier so we don't collide with PTO. Any objections? :calendar:
Kevin: I prefer moving it earlier too. Quick note: if we shift, branch freeze moves up — we need all PRs merged + changelog entries by EOD Friday a week before the new date.
Maya: moving earlier is fine for my team but can we keep the usual weekday cutover? Also confirm whether we bump patch or minor for the infra configs change I have.
Kevin: For infra-only changes use patch (x.y.(z+1)). If there's any public API surface change, bump minor and add release notes under `changelog/unreleased`.
DevOps Bot: Automated reminder: Upcoming release train window change proposed by @Ana. Current train: biweekly Wed 08:00 UTC. Proposed new train: Wed (one week earlier) 08:00 UTC. If you have blockers, reply in-thread or tag @eng-oncall. <https://calendar.redwood.com/biweekly|release calendar>
Sam: I'm OOO Mon-Wed that week — can do final review Thurs morning. If we shift earlier, can someone cover my canary verification? @Oliver? :wave:
Oliver: I can take canary checks. Will update the release job schedule (GitHub Actions) and bump the `release/schedule` cron to match. I'll also add a follow-up to the PR template to remind owners to run `make smoke` locally.
Maya: Thanks — on the infra bump: small config toggle only, so patch is fine. I'll push a PR today and add a changelog snippet under `changelog/unreleased/infra.md`.
Ana (releases): Great — sounds like consensus. Plan: 1) move train one week earlier 2) freeze cutoffs EOD Fri (one week before) 3) Kevin to run release notes sweep 4) Oliver covers canary 5) Maya to mark PR and changelog. I'll update the calendar event and post a checklist in #eng-releases tomorrow.
Kevin: Also reminder to tag PRs with `release-train/<date>` so we can filter during the sweep. Example: `release-train/2026-04-01`.
Ana (releases): Will do. If anyone hits a hard blocker to meeting the earlier cutoff, call it out here before EOD. Otherwise I'll push the calendar change at 18:00 UTC and send a short release checklist. :white_check_mark:
